draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Vadakara! Lokanarkavu temple here is about 1,500 years old, with rock-cut caves and murals, and it was made famous by the Vadakkan Pattukal, the ballads of North Malabar. The French once called the town Bargaret.
draft.hungryLine: Vadakara has easy, no-fuss places to eat near the bus and railway stations.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Drive 5 km to Lokanarkavu Temple for its caves and murals, and stop at Chennamangalam Temple on the way.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Catch the sunset at Silent Beach, opposite Sandbanks Bungalow.
moodReplies.surprise-me: A new species of tardigrade, or water bear, found on the Vadakara coast was named Stygarctus keralensis, after Kerala.

spots.name: Chennamangalam Temple
spots.detail: 2 km · Famous for its Dhwaja Prathishta

spots.name: Lokanarkavu Temple
spots.detail: 5 km · Rock-cut caves, murals and carvings

legends.title: The goddess ready for war
legends.body: At Lokanarkavu, Durga is believed to sit in a war form, waiting for the battle cry. Many myths and stories surround the temple.

legends.title: The ballad heroes
legends.body: The temple is tied to the Vadakkan Pattukal ballads and the brave deeds of the Thacholi family of knights. Those songs made it famous across Malabar.

tips.title: Waterfall season is Jun to Dec.
tips.body: Thirikkakkayam waterfalls near Vanimel drop 50 metres and draw crowds from June to December.

tips.title: Shop for crafts at Iringal.
tips.body: Sargaalaya Arts & Crafts Village, 22 km away, sells goods made of banana fibre, coir, bamboo and coconut shells.

story.title: Caves and murals
story.body: Lokanarkavu Temple took shape with rock-cut caves, murals and carvings that still stand today.

story.title: Kadathanadu
story.body: Under the Kolathiris and Zamorins, the area around Vadakara was known as Kadathanadu.

story.title: Malabar under the British
story.body: Vadakara became part of the North Malabar region of Malabar District, in Madras. The Basel Evangelical Church opened on the Moorad river in 1864.

story.title: A busy taluk town
story.body: Vadakara is a municipality and taluk headquarters, bordered by Mahé to the north and Payyoli to the south.
